newsitem.title: USA: American Resources says Gulf production up.
newsitem.headline: American Resources says Gulf production up.

text.p: American Resources of Delaware Inc said on Monday that its current net rate of production from all of its Gulf of Mexico properties has increased to 1,090 barrels (BBLS) of oil and 7,735 thousand cubic feet (MCF) of gas per day
This compares with an average of 444 BBLS of oil and 469 MCF of gas per day for the first nine months of 1996, the company said.

The company said the increase came from the wells located on South Timbalier 148, which the company acquired from Century Offshore Management Corp in July of this year, and which have now been successfully completed.
Newfield Exploration Co is the operator of the field and is also a joint working interest owner of the wells, the company said.
